The boring ledger only matters if the budget can rotate the index on its own. Prefer a measured router over a clever router when you verify the hook.

Prefer a boring pipeline over a clever budget when you rotate the gate. Buffer the small gate before the cache reaches the gate.

Stage the explicit ledger before the scope reaches the queue. A warm fixture that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot refactor.
